literal: With those born of noble family, except, do not exist naturally, integrity and modesty, together.
translation: Integrity and a sense of shame do not naturally exist together in anyone, except in those born of noble lineage.
modern: உயர்ந்த குடியில் பிறந்தவர்களிடம் அல்லாமல் மற்றவர்களிடம் நேர்மையும் நாணமும் இயற்கையாகவே ஒருசேர இருப்பதில்லை.
explanation: This couplet highlights the defining qualities of noble birth. The poet states that uprightness (செப்பம்), which represents integrity and fairness, and modesty (நாண்), which is the healthy sense of shame that prevents one from doing wrong, naturally coexist only in those born of a noble family. In others, these two virtues do not come together as an inherent nature. The word 'செப்பம்' refers to impartiality or rectitude, while 'நாண்' refers to the shrinking back from dishonorable deeds. Together, they form the bedrock of noble character.
